items.title: Three parts, always in this order
items.caption: Tap a part to read what it does. Word by word the sentence says "Past I go", which English says as "I went."

parts.note: It goes in front and stamps the whole sentence as already done. It is always first, and it never changes.
It says who did it, in the slot before the verb. Swap it for *ia* and the same sentence is about someone else.
It names the action and keeps the same shape whether the going is past, present or still to come.
